name: Goran Vukić
bio:
Goran Vukić's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for tinkering with engines. Growing up in Zagreb, he spent countless hours disassembling and reassembling anything he could get his hands on, much to the dismay of his parents. This passion led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, after which he started his career in a small, local racing team. He quickly rose through the ranks, showcasing a knack for identifying performance bottlenecks and implementing innovative solutions. 

Goran's approach to technical direction is rooted in a deep understanding of vehicle dynamics and a collaborative leadership style. He believes in empowering his team to explore new ideas while maintaining a focus on data-driven decision-making. His time at Hot Car Competições has been marked by a renewed focus on long-term R&D, and a willingness to embrace new technologies in pursuit of competitive advantage. Goran distinguishes himself with his ability to blend seasoned experience with an open mind to modern engineering advancements.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Goran is a man of medium build with a perpetually thoughtful expression etched on his face.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific brand of strong, dark coffee before every race.
